pages.text: $(l)Energy$()$(li)To maximize Dyson energy ball output, use multiple pylons (each provides maxint power) or phantom faces; 1024× dischargers require multiple input pylons.

$(li)A 256× discharger tier is sufficient for Eye of Galifrey passive crafting and leaves adequate overhead; higher tiers are optional.$(li)Do not rely on random tick speed to speed up black hole tank filling—use Actually Additions fluid lasers (2.1 billion mb/t) instead.

$(l)Fluids$()$(li)To feed 120 definers, players have used a drawer wall with one conduit per hatch, a single AE2 subnet with export buses, or 14 networks of 8 fluids each over fluid P2P. All of these work.

$(l)Farming & Crafting$()$(li)Terrestrial Cauldrons become the primary bottleneck for halite production; passive crafting of cauldron components is recommended once ingredients are abundant.$(li)Fluid replicators are very fast and do not require overclocking.
